warmup_rule: len(replay)>64; unspecified in paper, retained from public implementation
epsilon_assumption: Epsilon fixed within episode, multiplied0.9995 after episode, matching previous once-per-episode optimizer regime; paper does not specify schedule. It is not decayed at every new gradient update.
paper_changes: Optimize after every control transition following replay warmup (Table2).
Loss only on sampled Q(s,a), detached TD targets (Eq9).
Both exit and301-step episode timeout have zero bootstrap (Table2 terminal branch).
Target network synchronized every50 global control steps, including warmup, after that step's update (Table2).
retained_assumptions: Original author Maze reward/integration, initial FED, arrival-node5-second floor sampling and zero exit dose retained; code-level ordering is not fully specified in paper.
Original301-step finite episode limit retained and treated as terminal; position-only state hides time, cumulative FED and visits.
Original single61-unit ReLU hidden layer and Adam retained; paper does not uniquely specify network/optimizer.
Per-episode deterministic reset seeds drawn from numpy Generator(100000+seed); same paired initial policy weights and same reset sequence as previous runs.
No legal-action masking, clipping, teacher loss or new observation features.
